decisions.reason: As a waterproof lined safety shoe range close to our core offer, it likely still fits a growing PPE market, though niche demand and normal portfolio refreshes create some risk of discontinuation.
An electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe matches a durable workplace need and our innovation-led positioning, so it is more likely to stay in the assortment than be withdrawn soon.

A safety shoe series sits at the heart of our established business and broad product range, so absent clear failure signals we would usually retain it, while allowing for some chance of replacement by a newer series.
